name: Azure Resource Manager inventory snapshots
description: Azure Resource Manager inventory snapshots collected by the Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services (mscs sourcetypes): virtual machines, disks, NICs, public IPs, NSGs, VNets, images, snapshots, resource groups, subscriptions and network topology.
source: Azure REST API reference (Microsoft Learn, docs-ref-autogen from Azure/azure-rest-api-specs); field names and CIM-style aliases confirmed against captured samples and indexed mscs:resource:* events.

feed.label: Azure Resource Manager inventory snapshots
feed.description: Periodic ARM inventory snapshots the Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Cloud Services collects per resource kind: one event per resource (or, for topology, per resource node) as the ARM control-plane GET/LIST APIs return it.

resource_id.label: Resource ID
resource_id.description: The Azure Resource Manager resource ID: /subscriptions/{id}/resourceGroups/{rg}/providers/{provider}/{type}/{name}.

resource_name.label: Resource name
resource_name.description: The resource's own name, the last path segment of its resource ID.

arm_type.label: ARM resource type
arm_type.description: The Azure Resource Manager type string for the resource, for example Microsoft.Compute/disks.

location.label: Location
location.description: The Azure region the resource was deployed to.

resource_group.label: Resource group
resource_group.description: The resource group the resource belongs to; extracted by the collector from the resource ID's resourceGroups segment.

subscription_id.label: Subscription ID
subscription_id.description: The Azure subscription the resource belongs to; extracted by the collector from the resource ID's subscriptions segment.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: The resource's tags: a flat object on most containers, reshaped to a list of 'key : value' strings by the VM collector.

etag.label: Etag
etag.description: A read-only string that changes whenever the resource is updated; concurrency control, not a stable identifier.

resource_guid.label: Resource GUID
resource_guid.description: A GUID the platform assigns to the resource, separate from its ARM resource ID.

managed_by.label: Managed by
managed_by.description: The resource ID of the resource that manages this one, for example the VM a disk is attached to.

provisioning_state.label: Provisioning state
provisioning_state.description: The resource's Azure Resource Manager provisioning state.

sku_name.label: SKU name
sku_name.description: The resource's stock-keeping-unit name, deciding its performance tier, for example Standard_LRS or Basic.

sku_tier.label: SKU tier
sku_tier.description: The performance or service tier of the resource's SKU.

time_created.label: Created time
time_created.description: When the resource was created, as the platform recorded it.

unique_id.label: Platform unique ID
unique_id.description: A GUID the platform assigns identifying this exact resource instance, separate from its ARM resource ID and its user-assigned name.

network_access_policy.label: Network access policy
network_access_policy.description: The policy for accessing the disk or snapshot's export/upload URI via network.

public_network_access.label: Public network access
public_network_access.description: Whether the disk or snapshot's export/upload URI can be reached from the public internet.

os_type.label: OS type
os_type.description: The operating system on the disk: Windows or Linux.

disk_state.label: Disk state
disk_state.description: The state of the disk or snapshot: whether it is attached, reserved, frozen, or mid-upload.

disk_size_gb.label: Disk size (GB)
disk_size_gb.description: The disk or snapshot's size in gigabytes.

disk_size_bytes.label: Disk size (bytes)
disk_size_bytes.description: The disk or snapshot's size in bytes; read-only.

encryption_type.label: Encryption type
encryption_type.description: The kind of key used to encrypt the disk or snapshot's data at rest.

create_option.label: Create option
create_option.description: How the disk, snapshot or VM data disk was created: from an image, an empty volume, a copy, an upload or a restore, one of eleven fixed values.

source_resource_id.label: Source resource ID
source_resource_id.description: The ARM resource ID of the disk or snapshot this one was copied from.

source_unique_id.label: Source unique ID
source_unique_id.description: The platform unique ID of the resource this snapshot's source was created from.

incremental.label: Incremental snapshot
incremental.description: Whether the snapshot is incremental (occupies less space, can be diffed against the family).

disk_io_counter.label: Disk I/O counter
disk_io_counter.description: A per-disk I/O counter this pack observed with real numeric values on seeded events. Azure's Disk REST schema returns only provisioned IOPS/throughput limits (diskIOPSReadWrite, diskMBpsReadWrite), not live counters, so this pack cannot confirm which meter (reads, writes, ops, or blocks) beyond what the column name states.

service_family.label: Service family
service_family.description: A fixed label naming the Azure service that owns this resource, for example 'Azure Virtual Machines' or 'Azure Virtual Network'. Not a per-resource vendor field: observed constant per resource kind in the dev Splunk.

promotion_ref.label: Billing promotion
promotion_ref.description: A billing promotion entry this pack observed on seeded subscription events; not part of the Subscriptions - Get definitions this pack cites, so its structure (category, endDateTime) is inferred from the field names alone.

empty_extraction.label: Unpopulated extraction
empty_extraction.description: A field this sourcetype's index-time extraction defines but that stayed empty on every event this pack observed (samples and dev Splunk); likely scoped to a resource shape outside this pack's samples.

vm_platform_id.label: VM platform ID
vm_platform_id.description: The Azure-assigned unique identifier for the VM: a GUID distinct from the VM's own ARM resource ID.

vm_size.label: VM size
vm_size.description: The VM's size/SKU, for example Standard_DS3_v2, which decides its CPU and memory allocation.

power_state.label: Power state
power_state.description: The VM's current power state, reported as an instance-view status code such as PowerState/running.

computer_name.label: Computer name
computer_name.description: The VM's hostname, set in its OS profile or reported back by the guest agent.

admin_username.label: Admin username
admin_username.description: The local administrator account name provisioned on the VM.

image_publisher.label: Image publisher
image_publisher.description: The publisher of the platform image the VM (or image) was created from, for example MicrosoftWindowsServer.

image_offer.label: Image offer
image_offer.description: The offer of the platform image the VM was created from, for example WindowsServer.

image_sku.label: Image SKU
image_sku.description: The SKU of the platform image the VM was created from, for example 2016-Datacenter.

image_version.label: Image version
image_version.description: The version of the platform image the VM was created from, or 'latest'.

os_disk_caching.label: Disk caching mode
os_disk_caching.description: The host caching mode for the disk: None, ReadOnly or ReadWrite.

managed_disk_storage_type.label: Managed disk storage type
managed_disk_storage_type.description: The storage account type backing a managed disk reference, for example Premium_LRS.

managed_disk_ref_id.label: Managed disk reference
managed_disk_ref_id.description: The resource ID of a managed disk referenced from another resource (a VM's disk slot, an image's source disk).

data_disk_lun.label: Data disk LUN
data_disk_lun.description: The logical unit number identifying a data disk's attach point on the VM or image.

network_interface_ref_id.label: Network interface reference
network_interface_ref_id.description: The resource ID of a network interface attached to this VM.

boot_diagnostics_enabled.label: Boot diagnostics enabled
boot_diagnostics_enabled.description: Whether boot diagnostics are enabled for the VM.

boot_diagnostics_uri.label: Boot diagnostics URI
boot_diagnostics_uri.description: The storage account URI boot diagnostics are written to.

availability_set_id.label: Availability set reference
availability_set_id.description: The resource ID of the availability set the VM belongs to.

proximity_placement_group_id.label: Proximity placement group reference
proximity_placement_group_id.description: The resource ID of the proximity placement group the VM belongs to.

user_data.label: User data
user_data.description: Base64-encoded custom data supplied when the VM was created; may carry provisioning secrets.

vm_cpu_cores.label: vCPU count
vm_cpu_cores.description: The VM's vCPU count; computed by the collector from the VM size, not a field the vendor response returns.

vm_mem_capacity.label: Memory capacity
vm_mem_capacity.description: The VM's memory capacity; computed by the collector from the VM size, not a field the vendor response returns.

vm_storage_capacity.label: Storage capacity
vm_storage_capacity.description: A storage capacity figure the collector reports for the VM; not a field the vendor response returns.

vm_ref_id.label: Attached VM reference
vm_ref_id.description: The resource ID of the VM a network interface is attached to.

mac_address.label: MAC address
mac_address.description: The MAC address of the network interface.

nic_primary.label: Primary NIC
nic_primary.description: Whether this is the primary network interface on the virtual machine.

enable_ip_forwarding.label: IP forwarding enabled
enable_ip_forwarding.description: Whether IP forwarding is enabled on this network interface.

enable_accelerated_networking.label: Accelerated networking enabled
enable_accelerated_networking.description: Whether the network interface is configured for accelerated networking.

nic_type.label: NIC type
nic_type.description: The kind of network interface resource: Standard or Elastic.

dns_servers.label: DNS servers
dns_servers.description: The list of DNS server IP addresses configured on the interface or network.

applied_dns_servers.label: Applied DNS servers
applied_dns_servers.description: The union of DNS servers applied across every NIC in the VM's availability set.

internal_domain_name_suffix.label: Internal domain name suffix
internal_domain_name_suffix.description: The DNS suffix used to build this NIC's internal (VNet-scoped) FQDN.

private_ip_address.label: Private IP address
private_ip_address.description: The private IP address of the interface's IP configuration.

ip_version.label: IP address version
ip_version.description: Whether the IP configuration is IPv4 or IPv6.

ip_allocation_method.label: IP allocation method
ip_allocation_method.description: Whether the IP address is statically assigned or dynamically allocated.

subnet_ref_id.label: Subnet reference
subnet_ref_id.description: The resource ID of the subnet this IP configuration or resource sits in.

public_ip_ref_id.label: Public IP reference
public_ip_ref_id.description: The resource ID of the public IP address bound to this IP configuration.

nsg_ref_id.label: Network security group reference
nsg_ref_id.description: The resource ID of the network security group protecting this resource.

auxiliary_mode.label: Auxiliary mode
auxiliary_mode.description: The auxiliary mode of the network interface resource (Azure Boost networking).

auxiliary_sku.label: Auxiliary SKU
auxiliary_sku.description: The auxiliary SKU of the network interface resource (Azure Boost networking).

disable_tcp_state_tracking.label: TCP state tracking disabled
disable_tcp_state_tracking.description: Whether TCP state tracking is disabled on this network interface.

default_outbound_connectivity_enabled.label: Default outbound connectivity enabled
default_outbound_connectivity_enabled.description: Whether default outbound internet connectivity was configured for this NIC.

allow_port25_out.label: Port 25 outbound allowed
allow_port25_out.description: A network interface property this pack observed; not present in the 2024-05-01 NetworkInterfacePropertiesFormat definitions this pack checked, so likely an older or preview api-version property. The name suggests an SMTP (TCP/25) egress control.

address_prefixes.label: Address space
address_prefixes.description: The IP address ranges (CIDR blocks) available for subnets in the virtual network.

enable_ddos_protection.label: DDoS protection enabled
enable_ddos_protection.description: Whether DDoS protection is enabled for the virtual network.

subnet_address_prefix.label: Subnet address prefix
subnet_address_prefix.description: The CIDR block of one subnet within the virtual network.

virtual_network_peerings.label: VNet peerings
virtual_network_peerings.description: The virtual network's peering connections to other virtual networks.

default_nat_gateway_id.label: Default NAT gateway reference
default_nat_gateway_id.description: The resource ID of the default NAT gateway for the virtual network's outbound traffic.

security_rule_access.label: Security rule access
security_rule_access.description: Whether the security rule allows or denies the traffic it matches.

security_rule_direction.label: Security rule direction
security_rule_direction.description: Whether the security rule is evaluated on inbound or outbound traffic.

security_rule_protocol.label: Security rule protocol
security_rule_protocol.description: The network protocol the security rule applies to.

security_rule_priority.label: Security rule priority
security_rule_priority.description: The rule's priority (100-4096); lower numbers are evaluated first.

security_rule_source_prefix.label: Security rule source prefix
security_rule_source_prefix.description: The source CIDR or address tag the security rule matches.

security_rule_dest_prefix.label: Security rule destination prefix
security_rule_dest_prefix.description: The destination CIDR or address tag the security rule matches.

security_rule_source_port.label: Security rule source port range
security_rule_source_port.description: The source port or port range the security rule matches.

security_rule_dest_port.label: Security rule destination port range
security_rule_dest_port.description: The destination port or port range the security rule matches.

security_rules.label: Custom security rules
security_rules.description: The NSG's own security rules, as opposed to its subscription-default rules.

ip_address.label: Public IP address
ip_address.description: The public IP address assigned to this resource.

dns_domain_name_label.label: DNS domain name label
dns_domain_name_label.description: The domain name label that, concatenated with the regional DNS zone, forms the resource's FQDN.

dns_domain_name_label_scope.label: DNS domain name label scope
dns_domain_name_label_scope.description: The reuse scope for the domain name label's hashed FQDN.

fqdn.label: FQDN
fqdn.description: The fully qualified domain name of the DNS record associated with the public IP.

idle_timeout_minutes.label: Idle timeout (minutes)
idle_timeout_minutes.description: The idle timeout of the public IP address, in minutes.

ip_configuration_ref_id.label: IP configuration reference
ip_configuration_ref_id.description: The resource ID of the IP configuration this public IP is bound to.

ddos_protection_mode.label: DDoS protection mode
ddos_protection_mode.description: The DDoS protection mode applied to the public IP address.

tenant_id.label: Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: The Microsoft Entra tenant the subscription belongs to.

managed_by_tenant_id.label: Managing tenant ID
managed_by_tenant_id.description: The tenant ID of a tenant that manages this subscription (Lighthouse delegation).

authorization_source.label: Authorization source
authorization_source.description: The authorization source of the request that returned this subscription: Legacy, RoleBased, Bypassed, Direct, Management, or a combination.

location_placement_id.label: Location placement ID
location_placement_id.description: The ID that decides which Azure regions are visible for this subscription.

subscription_enabled.label: Subscription enabled flag
subscription_enabled.description: A yes/no flag the collector derives from the subscription's state (Enabled -> yes); the vendor API itself returns only the state enum, not a separate boolean.

association_name.label: Association name
association_name.description: The name of the resource associated with the parent resource in the topology snapshot.

association_ref_id.label: Association reference
association_ref_id.description: The resource ID of the resource associated with the parent resource; the topology graph's join key.

association_type.label: Association type
association_type.description: The kind of association between the child and parent resource in the topology snapshot.

topology_resource_label.label: Topology resource label
topology_resource_label.description: A human-friendly resource-kind label the collector derives from the resource's ARM type, for example 'Virtual Machine' for a Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines id. Not a Topology API field.

instance_status_code.label: Instance-view status code
instance_status_code.description: A status code from an Azure Compute instance-view sub-resource (a disk, an extension, the VM agent, a patch operation): PowerState/*, ProvisioningState/*, or a component-specific code.

instance_status_display.label: Instance-view status text
instance_status_display.description: The human-readable status or message text paired with an instance-view status code.

instance_status_level.label: Instance-view status level
instance_status_level.description: The severity of an instance-view status: Info, Warning or Error.

instance_status_time.label: Instance-view status time
instance_status_time.description: When an instance-view status was last set.

os_name.label: Guest OS name
os_name.description: The operating system name the VM agent reports from inside the guest.

os_version.label: Guest OS version
os_version.description: The operating system version the VM agent reports from inside the guest.

hyperv_generation.label: HyperV generation
hyperv_generation.description: The hypervisor generation of the virtual machine: V1 or V2.

vm_agent_version.label: VM agent version
vm_agent_version.description: The Azure VM Guest Agent's own version string.

extension_version.label: Extension handler version
extension_version.description: The type handler version of a VM extension or agent extension handler.

extension_publisher.label: Extension publisher
extension_publisher.description: The publisher of a VM extension child resource.

extension_auto_upgrade.label: Extension auto-upgrades minor version
extension_auto_upgrade.description: Whether a VM extension automatically upgrades to the latest minor version.

vm_in_standby_pool.label: VM in standby pool
vm_in_standby_pool.description: Whether the VM currently sits in a standby pool.

platform_domain.label: Platform fault/update domain
platform_domain.description: The platform fault domain or update domain index the VM is placed in.

extensions_time_budget.label: Extensions time budget
extensions_time_budget.description: The time allotted for all extensions to start on the VM, an ISO 8601 duration such as PT1H30M.

mscs:resource:virtualMachine.description: Azure Virtual Machine inventory snapshot: the ARM VirtualMachine object merged with its InstanceView (runtime state).
mscs:resource:virtualMachine.note: properties.instanceView is appended to the LIST-shaped VM object by the collector's own InstanceView call; tags are reshaped from an object to a list of 'key : value' strings.

mscs:resource:publicIPAddress.description: Azure public IP address inventory snapshot.

mscs:resource:securityGroup.description: Azure network security group (NSG) inventory snapshot.

mscs:resource:image.description: Azure custom (managed) VM image inventory snapshot.

mscs:resource:topology.description: Azure network topology snapshot: one event per resource element of a Network Watcher topology response.
mscs:resource:topology.note: Each event is one TopologyResource from the topology's resources[] array, not the top-level Topology object (its id/createdDateTime/lastModified are not present on these events).

azure_ids_look_alike.text: An Azure resource carries several different identifiers that are not interchangeable: the ARM resource id (a path), a platform GUID (vmId, uniqueId, resourceGuid), and sometimes a column of the same name meaning a different resource on a different container (a NIC's vm_id names the attached VM, not the NIC). Match by concept, not by column name.
